subject: Request: One-off off-ramp & ramp-down protections for Clearwave deal
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: One-off off-ramp & ramp-down protections for Clearwave deal

Team —

Quick context: Clearwave Diagnostics (late-stage medtech) is asking for two contract departures to sign this quarter: a) an off-ramp/early-termination opt-out after month 6 and b) a single permitted downsell (capacity decrease) in the first 12 months. Deal economics: $420k ARR committed on a 12-month term (customer asked for 12 v. our standard 24). They want a one-time onboarding credit and the ability to scale down if usage remains below expectations.

Specific ask (what Sales agreed in product/CS conversations):
- Ramp schedule: month 1 = 50% committed capacity (onboarding), month 2 = 75%, months 3-6 = 100%.
- Downsell (one-time): allow up to 25% reduction of committed capacity after month 4 with 60 days notice, no automatic penalty, and preserve existing price tier.
- Off-ramp/early-termination: opt-out after month 6 with a pro-rated credit equal to 50% of remaining committed monthly charges (cap requested by customer = $75,000).
- Commercial concession: one-time onboarding credit equal to 12% of first-year committed ARR (approx $50,400) to be paid as invoice credit.

Attachments: I attached a redline addendum and the pricing workbook that shows the concession math.

Ask to you all: I need a quick decision on whether we can approve these departures and any guardrails (cap on credit, escrow, DocuSign clause, requirement for addendum). If we can approve, I need an explicit signed exec approval string I can send to Clearwave so Legal can finalize the addendum.

Impact note: If we refuse, they will likely push to a different vendor and we lose the ARR this quarter — high likelihood of churn on the pipeline.

Can you review and respond by EOD Wed (5/5)?

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Attachments: Clearwave_Addendum_redline.docx (redline), pricing-workbook.xlsx (sensitivity model)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-off off-ramp & ramp-down protections for Clearwave deal

On Tue, May 4, 2027 at 9:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick context: Clearwave Diagnostics (late-stage medtech) is asking for two contract departures to sign this quarter: a) an off-ramp/early-termination opt-out after month 6 and b) a single permitted downsell (capacity decrease) in the first 12 months. 

Karthik — thanks for the write-up. Two clarifying questions before Marissa and finance chime in:
1) Is the customer asking for the $75k cap on the early-termination credit or is that our proposed cap? I need the ask vs offer delineated.
2) Is the onboarding credit applied as a one-time invoice credit or amortized over Qs? That affects revenue recognition and finance approval.

If the customer is driving the $75k number we should negotiate down (recommend $50k cap) and require the credit to be escrowed on signature (or amortized over three months). Also, Marissa — if Legal can insert a single-use "downscale buffer" clause that requires 60-day notice, we may accept without additional penalties.

Please flag if this needs an executive signature (Vivek or CFO) versus a deal-desk sign-off.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-off off-ramp & ramp-down protections for Clearwave deal

Thanks for the details — reviewed the redline and workbook. Recommendation below (Deal Desk + Legal):

Summary of recommended concessions (controlled):
- Onboarding credit: APPROVE at 12% of first-year committed ARR (~$50,400) but must be applied as a one-time invoice credit and amortized for revenue-recognition purposes over Q1 post-go-live (finance to confirm amortization policy).
- Early-termination credit (off-ramp): APPROVE conditional cap = $50,000 (not customer-requested $75k). Calculation = 50% * remaining committed monthly charges, floored at $0 and capped at $50k. This limits downside while giving Clearwave a safety valve.
- Downsell / downscale buffer: APPROVE a single-use 25% capacity reduction after month 4 with 60 days' prior notice. Condition: preserved price tier only if customer remains within same usage band; any subsequent reductions subject to standard unwind terms.
- Term: accept 12-month term for this account in exchange for the above concessions, but require a 30-day notice window for renewal and an option to convert to 24 months at the same price.

Required operational guardrails before final approval:
1) Addendum must be signed and uploaded to HubSpot (I added the HubSpot link in metadata).
2) Finance must confirm the amortization schedule for the onboarding credit and sign off on the $50k cap.
3) RevOps to flag the account for manual monitoring for first 6 months (Monica, please own).
4) Require a clause that any early-termination credit must be funded from an escrow account or invoiced as a negative invoice and clearly documented in the addendum (Legal redline attached).

If Finance confirms the $50k cap, Deal Desk will approve. Legal questions remain around escrow language (Marissa: please coordinate with Legal on wording).

Attachments referenced: Clearwave_Addendum_redline.docx (I inserted the conditional cap and downscale buffer language), pricing-workbook.xlsx (updated with $50k cap scenario).

- Marissa Cole
Marissa Cole
Manager, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-off off-ramp & ramp-down protections for Clearwave deal

Marissa / Team —

I authorize the controlled concessions outlined by Deal Desk with the following executive conditions (final approval granted):
1) Early-termination cap = $50,000 (Deal Desk calculation).
2) Onboarding credit = 12% applied as a one-time invoice credit and amortized per Finance guidance.
3) Single-use downscale buffer allowed once after month 4 with 60 days' notice, preserved price tier clause as drafted.
4) Addendum must be executed (DocuSign link above) and escrow language included; RevOps to place a monitoring flag and daily usage alerts for first 90 days.

Please proceed: Legal/RevOps/Finance to finalize the addendum (use Marissa's redline), upload signed copy to HubSpot, and Karthik to confirm customer acceptance. Monica — please start the RevOps monitoring playbook after signature.

Once the signed addendum is in place, Sales may send the final DocuSign link to Clearwave and close the loop.

Approved by: Vivek Kulkarni
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
